```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    # 09:00 Beijing time (UTC+8) is 01:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  post-coffee-lottery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Build Coffee Bot
        run: mvn -B package -DskipTests

      - name: Run Coffee Bot Lottery Poster
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # Assuming the bot uses MCP or similar interface enabled for bot workflows
          MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          java -jar target/coffee-bot-*.jar post-lottery
```
